resources.string: DuoDesk: your computer’s mouse and keyboard

Lets the computer you paired in DuoDesk tap, scroll and type on this phone with its mouse and keyboard when wireless debugging isn’t available (for example over Bluetooth). DuoDesk acts on input from your paired computer. Accessibility can read the focused field to type, identify the foreground app, and, when ReZume is enabled, read supported browser address bars. You can turn this access off in Android settings.
